title: kissed silky turkish lamb pilaf
description: a rich and creamy pilaf dish featuring cured lamb and fluffy rice, sure to impress any dinner guest

ingredients.name: lamb shoulder
ingredients.notes: cured in shio-koji for at least 2 hours

instructions: heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat
add the chopped onion and sauté until translucent, about 5 minutes
add the minced garlic and sauté for another minute
add the lamb shoulder, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks
add the smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, stirring to combine
add the white rice and stir to combine with the lamb mixture
cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly, until the rice is lightly toasted
add 2 cups of water to the saucepan and bring to a boil
reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 18-20 minutes, or until the rice is cooked
stir in the heavy whipping cream and season with salt and black pepper to taste
garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately
